text: PaXSubstituteEpsilon is an option for PaXEvaluate. For brevity, Package-X normally abbreviates 1/Epsilon - EulerGamma + Log[4Pi] with 1/Epsilon (see DimRegEpsilon in the Documentation of Package-X).
When SubstituteEpsilon is set to True, PaXEvaluate will undo this abbreviation to obtain the full result.
